newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Surgutneftegaz to issue bonus shares.
newsitem.headline: Russian Surgutneftegaz to issue bonus shares.

text.p: Surgutneftegaz, Russia's third largest oil company, will issue 23.99 billion bonus shares, including 18.49 billion ordinary shares and 5.50 billion privileged shares, the company said on Tuesday.

"At a meeting on June 30, the board of directors of OAO Surgutneftegaz decided, in connection with a reevaluation (of the company), to issue 23.99 billion shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles," a company statement said.
The shares will be issued free to shareholders from June 30, in volumes proportional to the size of each shareholder's stake in the company.
For every share with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles, either ordinary or privileged, shareholders will receive a further four shares, the statement said.
Surgutneftegaz ordinary shares traded at $1.09 on the Russian Trading System at 1125 GMT, up almost three percent from Monday's close of $1.06.
Surgutneftegaz produced 33.3 million tonnes of oil in 1996, roughly flat on 1995 levels. The company said last month that output in 1997 would not fall below 1996 levels.
